mf_newforms.description: Classical holomorphic newforms on Gamma_0(N). Each row is a Galois orbit.

columns.label: text — Unique label N.k.c.x, e.g. '11.2.a.a'.
columns.char_orbit_label: text — Galois orbit of the character as a letter; 'a' = trivial. NOT char_label.
columns.char_orbit_index: integer — Integer index of character orbit; 1 = trivial.
columns.char_order: integer — Order of chi; 1 = trivial, 2 = real/quadratic.
columns.char_conductor: integer — Conductor of chi; 1 for trivial character.
columns.char_is_real: boolean — Whether chi takes only real values.
columns.char_parity: smallint — Parity of chi: +1 even, -1 odd.
columns.conrey_index: integer — Conrey index n; full label = level.n.
columns.dim: integer — Dimension of Galois orbit over Q.
columns.relative_dim: integer — Dimension over the character field.
columns.analytic_rank: integer — Order of vanishing of L(s,f) at central point.
columns.analytic_rank_proved: boolean — Whether analytic rank is rigorously proved.
columns.Nk2: integer — Product N*k^2; internal sort key.
columns.atkin_lehner_eigenvals: jsonb — [[p, eigenvalue], ...] for each prime p|N.
columns.atkin_lehner_string: text — String of +/- for AL eigenvalues.
columns.cm_discs: integer[] — Negative discriminants D s.t. form has CM by Q(sqrt(D)).
columns.rm_discs: integer[] — Positive discriminants D s.t. form has RM.
columns.is_cm: boolean — Whether the form has CM.
columns.is_rm: boolean — Whether the form has RM.
columns.is_self_dual: boolean — Whether form is isomorphic to its dual.
columns.is_self_twist: boolean — Whether form is a self-twist.
columns.inner_twists: jsonb — List of inner twist data.
columns.minimal_twist: text — Label of the twist-minimal form.
columns.nf_label: text — LMFDB label of Hecke field as number field. Null for dim=1.
columns.field_poly: integer[] — Coefficients of minimal polynomial of Hecke field.
columns.field_disc: integer — Discriminant of Hecke field. 1 for dim=1.
columns.field_poly_is_cyclotomic: boolean — Whether Hecke field is cyclotomic.
columns.field_poly_is_real_cyclotomic: boolean — Whether Hecke field is real cyclotomic.
columns.hecke_ring_index: numeric — Index of Hecke ring in full ring of integers.
columns.hecke_orbit: integer — Orbit index within the newspace.
columns.projective_image: text — Projective image of the mod-p representation.
columns.artin_image: text — Artin image label for weight-1 forms.
columns.artin_degree: integer — Degree of Artin representation for weight-1 forms.
columns.traces: integer[] — Hecke traces a_n for n=1..1000.
columns.trace_display: integer[] — First few Hecke traces for display.
columns.space_label: text — Label of the parent newspace.

mf_newspaces.description: Newspaces S_k^new(N, chi). Each row is a (level, weight, character orbit) triple.

columns.label: text — Label N.k.c, e.g. '11.2.a'.
columns.char_orbit_label: text — Character orbit label; 'a' = trivial. NOT char_label.
columns.dim: integer — Total dimension over all Galois orbits.
columns.hecke_orbit_dims: integer[] — Dimensions of each Galois orbit.
columns.trace_bound: integer — Trace bound for the space.

columns.label: text — LMFDB label.
columns.degree: integer — Degree d (number of Gamma factors).
columns.motivic_weight: integer — Motivic weight w; central point at s=(w+1)/2.
columns.root_number: float — Sign epsilon in functional equation.
columns.order_of_vanishing: integer — Order of vanishing at central point (analytic rank).
columns.self_dual: boolean — Whether L(s) equals its own dual.
columns.symmetry_type: text — Katz-Sarnak type: unitary, symplectic, orthogonal, SO(even), SO(odd).
columns.positive_zeros: float[] — Imaginary parts of nontrivial zeros (positive, analytic normalization).
columns.z1: float — Imaginary part of first zero.
columns.z2: float — Imaginary part of second zero.
columns.z3: float — Imaginary part of third zero.
columns.dirichlet_coefficients: jsonb — First few Dirichlet coefficients a_n.
columns.euler_factors: jsonb — Euler factors at good primes.
columns.bad_lfactors: jsonb — Local L-factors at bad primes.
columns.gamma_factors: jsonb — Gamma factors [mu_real, mu_imag, nu_real_doubled, nu_imag].
columns.Lhash: text — Hash identifier for the L-function.

lfunc_instances.description: Links from LMFDB objects to their L-functions.

columns.label: text — L-function label (foreign key into lfunc_lfunctions).
columns.type: text — Source object type: CMF, EC, G2C, NF, DIR, Artin.
columns.url: text — LMFDB URL of the source object.

ec_curvedata.description: Elliptic curves over Q. Primary key is lmfdb_label.

columns.lmfdb_label: text — PRIMARY KEY. LMFDB label N.isoN, e.g. '11.a1'. Use this for all filters.
columns.Ciso: text — Cremona isogeny class label, e.g. '11a'.
columns.lmfdb_iso: text — LMFDB isogeny class label, e.g. '11.a'.
columns.torsion: smallint — Order of E(Q)_tors. NOT torsion_order.
columns.torsion_structure: smallint[] — Torsion subgroup structure, e.g. [2,4] for Z/2 x Z/4.
columns.cm: smallint — 0 if no CM; else negative fundamental discriminant of CM field.
columns.isogeny_degrees: integer[] — Degrees of isogenies from E in its class.
columns.semistable: boolean — Whether E has semistable reduction everywhere.
columns.potential_good_reduction: boolean — Whether E has potential good reduction.
columns.modell_images: text[] — Images of mod-l Galois representations.
columns.nonmax_primes: integer[] — Primes l for which mod-l rep is non-maximal.
columns.degree: integer — Degree of the modular parametrization.
columns.optimality: smallint — Whether curve is the optimal Cremona model.
columns.num_bad_primes: smallint — Number of primes of bad reduction.

ec_mwbsd.description: Mordell-Weil and BSD data for elliptic curves over Q.

columns.lmfdb_label: text — LMFDB label (foreign key into ec_curvedata).
columns.gens: text[] — Mordell-Weil generators as projective coordinate strings.
columns.heights: float[] — Neron-Tate canonical heights of generators.
columns.real_period: jsonb — Real period Omega as high-precision literal {data: '...'}.
columns.sha_an: jsonb — Analytic |Sha| as high-precision literal. Cast: (sha_an->>'data')::float.
columns.special_value: jsonb — Special L-value L^(r)(E,1)/r! as high-precision literal.
columns.tamagawa_product: integer — Product of Tamagawa numbers over bad primes.
columns.rank_bounds: integer[] — Lower and upper bounds on rank.
columns.area: float — Area of the fundamental domain.

ec_localdata.description: Local reduction data for elliptic curves at each bad prime.

columns.prime: integer — Prime p of bad reduction.
columns.root_number: smallint — Local root number at p.
columns.kodaira_symbol: integer — Kodaira symbol encoded as integer.
columns.conductor_valuation: integer — Valuation of conductor at p.
columns.discriminant_valuation: integer — Valuation of discriminant at p.
columns.j_denominator_valuation: integer — Valuation of j-invariant denominator at p.

columns.label: text — LMFDB label d.r2.disc.n, e.g. '2.0.3.1' for Q(sqrt(-3)).
columns.r2: smallint — Number of complex place pairs. r1 = degree - 2*r2.
columns.class_group: integer[] — Invariants of the class group.
columns.galois_label: text — Galois group label as transitive subgroup of S_d, e.g. '4T3'.
columns.galt: integer — Galois group index in the transitive groups list.
columns.cm: boolean — Whether K is a CM field.
columns.coeffs: integer[] — Defining polynomial coefficients, lowest degree first.
columns.unit_signature_rank: integer — Rank of unit signature map.
columns.monogenic: boolean — Whether ring of integers is monogenic.
columns.torsion_order: integer — Order of torsion subgroup of units.
columns.used_grh: boolean — Whether GRH was assumed in computations.

columns.label: text — Conrey label q.n, e.g. '5.2'.
columns.orbit: integer — Orbit index within the modulus.
columns.primitive_orbit: integer — Orbit index of the primitive character inducing chi.
columns.order: integer — Order of chi; 1=trivial, 2=real/quadratic. Always quote as "order" in SQL.
columns.first: integer — First Conrey index in the orbit.
columns.last: integer — Last Conrey index in the orbit.
columns.is_real: boolean — Whether chi takes only real values.

g2c_curves.description: Genus-2 curves over Q. Note: conductor column is named 'cond', not 'conductor'.

columns.label: text — LMFDB label.
columns.cond: integer — Conductor of J(C). NOTE: column is 'cond', not 'conductor'.
columns.analytic_rank_proved: boolean — Whether analytic rank is proved.
columns.abs_disc: bigint — Absolute discriminant of the curve model.
columns.end_alg: text — Endomorphism algebra End^0(J): Q, QxQ, CM, RM, M_2(Q).
columns.is_gl2_type: boolean — Whether J is of GL_2-type.
columns.is_simple_base: boolean — Whether J is simple over Q.
columns.is_simple_geom: boolean — Whether J is geometrically simple.
columns.mw_rank_proved: boolean — Whether MW rank is proved.
columns.torsion_order: integer — Order of torsion subgroup of J(Q).
columns.num_rat_pts: smallint — Number of known rational points on C.
columns.num_rat_wpts: smallint — Number of rational Weierstrass points.
columns.globally_solvable: smallint — Whether C is everywhere locally solvable.
columns.has_square_sha: boolean — Whether |Sha| is a perfect square.
columns.eqn: text[] — Coefficients of the hyperelliptic model y^2 = f(x).
